verdicts.evidence: Forcing the name comparison to true makes corpusDrift blind to a corpus NAME change: with the lock pinned to acme@1.0.0 and runward/rules/corpus.json holding other@1.0.0, corpusDrift returned null instead of {pinned:{acme,1.0.0}, onDisk:{other,1.0.0}} — a mission vendored from a different corpus reports no drift. The version-only case still reports. No layer went red.
